name: Forge kernel
purpose: Decide the next build phase of a Hologram Forge app from its current phase and the event that just happened. Send phase or event, separated by spaces; it answers drafting, checked, proving, proved or published, and invalid request for anything else.

promise.headline: Says proved only after Lean attests the current rules.
promise.detail: Each answer is the next build phase from the current phase and one event. Lean proved four guarantees for every request: no proved without an attestation, no publish before proved, any edit returns to drafting, no proof run on unchecked rules.

claim: FK-01: the app never answers proved when phase is not proved and event is not attest. FK-02: the app never answers published when phase is not proved and phase is not published. FK-03: the app always answers drafting when event is edit. FK-04: the app never answers proving when phase is drafting.

proposition.name: judge
proposition.text:
judge request :=
  event is edit → drafting
  event is check and phase is drafting → checked
  event is approve and phase is checked → proving
  event is attest and phase is proving → proved
  event is fail and phase is proving → checked
  event is publish and phase is proved → published
  phase is drafting → drafting
  phase is checked → checked
  phase is proving → proving
  phase is proved → proved
  otherwise → published
proposition.plain: Decide the next build phase of a Hologram Forge app from its current phase and the event that just happened.
